issues.problem: Amazon's FY2022 gross profit was about $225.2B ($514.0B revenue minus $288.8B cost of sales), not $197.5B. The wrong figure makes gross profit growth look like about 37% when it was actually about 19.9%.

data.summary: All the figures are correct except FY2022 gross profit, which is overstated by understating the 2022 base: it was about $225.2B, not $197.5B.
